findings: BLOCKING: RideRequestScreen.confirmRide does not pass `pickupCoords` in the navigate call to TripActive. TripActiveScreen reads route.params?.pickupCoords?.lat (always undefined), so the route fetch on the passenger map always starts from Dar es Salaam city center (-6.7924, 39.2083) instead of the rider's actual location. Add `pickupCoords` to the navigate params alongside `destinationCoords`.

NON-BLOCKING: The `if (!estimatedFare)` guard inside estimateFare's .finally() callback captures stale React state (always null at closure-creation time), so the haversine fallback unconditionally overwrites the route-based fare on every successful route fetch. Fix by having calculateRoute return a success boolean and branching on that instead.

NON-BLOCKING: NavigationScreen's Nimefika button is gated on canArrive, which is only set by the GPS watcher. If the watcher never fires (poor GPS, silent catch), the button is permanently disabled and the driver cannot complete the trip. Add a timeout-based manual override.
